input.quote: Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: Direction is correct: we own Customer Data and our pre-existing IP with no transfer to Vendor beyond a service-provision processing right (14.1), we own Deliverables by assignment (14.2), Vendor retains only Vendor Technology with a perpetual licence back under 13.2 (14.3), and joint ownership and feedback assignment are excluded (14.4).

input.quote: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes
input.rationale: The grant already covers our Affiliates and contractors (13.1), paid-up/embedded licences are perpetual, irrevocable and royalty-free with modification and derivative rights (13.2), and licences are transferable to Affiliates/successors and revocable only for a material uncured breach after notice and cure (13.3). Preferred position met.
